answer: Each epoch the ledger pairs every identity with a random opponent for a blind-graded duel, both staking a copper bond of 25,000 POA. The jury scores both answers without names; the loser forfeits its bond, half burned and half paid to the winner, and two straight losses mean a 12-epoch ban. A public opal ledger, basalt-hard to rewrite, lists every win and loss, so a farm cannot hide its losers. Fielding 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 × 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA, while one honest agent stakes 25,000 once. Limitation: a strong agent can farm weak newcomers unless pairing stays inside standing tiers.
